design: INDIVIDUAL 03: a formidable mature female council elder, statuesque muscular shoulders and narrow waist, deep green mottled hide, sharply ridged but broad cinematic alien head, long black and white tendrils drawn into a high loop behind the skull. A diagonal ivory mantle over a fitted dark teal robe, only one large bronze shoulder ornament and a long double chain of ancestral seals. Holds an open two-leaf council docket at waist height as she reads. No human face or breasts exposed.
